name: Business Ethics
overview: Scripture calls believers to conduct business with integrity, rejecting theft, falsehood, and deceitful practices as seen in Leviticus 19:11 and Proverbs 11:1. Fair treatment of others, including prompt payment of wages and compassion toward the poor, reflects honoring God’s justice and mercy (Leviticus 19:13; Proverbs 19:17). Above material wealth, a good name and righteous character are prized, emphasizing that ethical conduct in commerce is a reflection of one’s devotion to the Lord (Proverbs 22:1). Isaiah 1:17 further exhorts believers to actively pursue justice and care for the vulnerable, grounding business ethics in a heart aligned with God’s commands.
